title: The Collins Elite as a fundamentalist faction inside government
summary: Jesse Michels tells of The Collins Elite as a fundamentalist faction inside government, about unspecified at US government, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: describe the Collins elite as this sort of uh very embedded in the government faction of of deeply fundamentalist Christians who don't want to study this stuff scientifically at all because they view it as demonic

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes something called the Collins Elite, which he says, drawing on Lou Elizondo and a private UFO group called To The Stars Academy, is a faction of deeply fundamentalist Christians embedded in the US government. According to Michels, they refuse to study UFOs scientifically because they see them as demonic, which, if true, would mean faith is shaping what the government is willing to look at.
